rest.documentation: The clinic directory. Every request needs a signed-in session (bearer token or the web app's cookie); only staff of a clinic see its resources, anyone else gets 404. Also GET /fhir/R4/metadata.

resource.documentation: Update renames the clinic (only the name changes) and needs If-Match with the version read; a stale or missing version gives 412. Only the clinic's admin may update.

searchParam.name: organization
searchParam.documentation: Required, one clinic id. No other search parameter is supported; any other gives 400.
